title: Virtual Card Management: Security Benefits of Virtual Cards
summary: This document explains how to use virtual card security controls: generate one-time/single-use cards (availability: Yes), revoke/cancel cards within 3 seconds to stop authorizations (block propagates within 3 seconds), and auto-refresh recurring card numbers on a configurable monthly schedule. It also covers best practices, audits, and documenting revocation/rotation procedures for finance and security teams.
